record.paper_title: Open Problems in the Function Theory of the Bergman Space
record.original_question: For zero sequences A and B in L2_a(D), let G_A and G_B denote their associated zero divisors. Define G ≺ H to mean ||Gf||_L2 ≤ ||Hf||_L2 for every bounded analytic function f in H∞(D). If A is contained in B as zero sequences, must the domination relation G_A ≺ G_B hold?

evidence.quote: The precise definition of G ≺ H, for G, H ∈ L2_a(D), is ||Gf||_L2 ≤ ||Hf||_L2, f ∈ H∞(D).
Conjecture 2.1. If A, B are two zero sequences for L2_a(D) having A ⊂ B, then G_A ≺ G_B.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}$ denote the open unit disk in $\mathbb{C}$, let $L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ denote the Bergman space of analytic functions on $\mathbb{D}$ that are square-integrable with respect to area measure, and let $H^\infty(\mathbb{D})$ denote the algebra of bounded analytic functions on $\mathbb{D}$. A sequence $A=\{a_j\}\subset\mathbb{D}$ is called a zero sequence for $L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ if there exists a non-identically-zero function in $L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ that vanishes precisely on $A$ (counted with multiplicity). For such a zero sequence $A$, let $G_A\in L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ denote the associated canonical (extremal) zero divisor, namely the unique function of unit $L^2$-norm in the closed subspace $I_A=\{f\in L^2_a(\mathbb{D}):f|_A=0\}$ that maximizes $\mathrm{Re}\,f(0)/\|f\|_2$ (equivalently, the contractive zero divisor in the Hedenmalm sense).

For two functions $G,H\in L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$, write $G\prec H$ to mean
$$\|Gf\|_{L^2(\mathbb{D})}\le \|Hf\|_{L^2(\mathbb{D})}\qquad\text{for every } f\in H^\infty(\mathbb{D}).$$

Prove or disprove: whenever $A$ and $B$ are zero sequences for $L^2_a(\mathbb{D})$ with $A\subset B$ (as multisets), the domination
$$G_A\prec G_B$$
holds.
artifact.status_search_result: A direct search for resolutions of this domination conjecture for canonical zero divisors in the Bergman space did not produce conclusive evidence either way. The conjecture (often attributed to Korenblum/Hedenmalm circles, with related work by Duren–Khavinson–Shapiro–Sundberg) is stated in Bergman-space surveys, but no published proof or counterexample establishing the general case A⊂B ⇒ G_A≺G_B was located, so the status here is recorded as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Recent Progress and Open Problems in the Bergman Space
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems on Bergman-space zero divisors and domination.
status_evidence.claim: The domination conjecture for canonical zero divisors is discussed among open problems on the Bergman space.

status_evidence.title: Contractive Zero-Divisors in Bergman Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Contractive zero divisors G are characterized by ||f/G||_p ≤ ||f||_p; domination introduced by Korenblum.
status_evidence.claim: The notion of domination G≺H in Bergman spaces is established but the general inclusion-implies-domination question is not resolved in this work.
